display_name: Digital mixing desk through an audio interface

identity.reason: A desk connected by an audio-only transport is represented by the audio interface endpoints and a user-confirmed route.

prohibited_assumptions: audio endpoint name proves the connected desk model
optical carrier proves ADAT rather than stereo S/PDIF
audio access implies fader, routing, scene, EQ, dynamics, or automation access
channel count is fixed without interface and sample-rate qualification
